_: Per-file budgets for raw HTML controls in ui/src, read by
scripts/gates/ds_components.py. THIS FILE IS THE ALLOWLIST — it is the one
source, and docs/architecture/ui.md 11.6 links here rather than restating it.
budgets is EMPTY, and that is the point: ui/src reaches zero raw controls.
Every control in the app comes from design-system/. The gate therefore fails
on any raw control anywhere in ui/src, because no file has a budget.
To add one back you must add an entry here saying why no design-system
component fits. Prefer extending a component additively — see the locked
rule in docs/architecture/ui.md 11.6 — over claiming an exception.
'bespoke' means a deliberate exception — no DS component fits.
'debt' means deferred migration tracked by an issue.

ui/src/planning/MonthGrid.tsx.note: The one remaining raw button is the event chip, which is an HTML drag source (draggable + onDragStart) feeding the month grid's drop targets; Button does not forward drag handlers. All non-drag chips use Button.

ui/src/planning/WeekGrid.tsx.note: The two remaining raw buttons are the all-day event chip and the timed event block: both are HTML drag sources, and the block is also absolutely positioned by duration (laneStyle). Button forwards neither draggable/onDragStart nor the geometry style contract. Static chips and day headers use Button.
